outcome: white matter microstructure indices (axial diffusivity, radial diffusivity, mean diffusivity) in the uncinate fasciculus
white matter microstructure indices (axial diffusivity, radial diffusivity, mean diffusivity) in the inferior longitudinal fasciculus
cohort: The study included 251 preterm infants (132 male, 119 female) with a median gestational age of 30.29 weeks.
finding: Higher maternal stressful life events scores were associated with higher axial, radial, and mean diffusivity in the left uncinate fasciculus, and higher axial diffusivity in the right uncinate fasciculus.
